skill.name: shareone
skill.description: Publish local HTML, Markdown, text, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, image, and archive files to ShareOne, then manage links, downloads, and comments.
skill.summary: Share files and generated pages through ShareOne with link settings, downloads, and comment workflows.
skill.author: sudoprivacy

security_audit.summary: Most external command, system reconnaissance, and obfuscation alerts are false positives from JavaScript template literals, Markdown examples, and multilingual prose. Real security concerns remain around external ShareOne network egress, local file reads for upload, plaintext credential storage, full API key output, and a user-controlled API base URL that can receive authenticated requests.

remediation.issue: User-provided URLs can control the API base URL for credentialed update requests.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist trusted ShareOne origins and reject or normalize non-ShareOne hosts before attaching API keys or proxy credentials.

remediation.issue: Scripts and workflows expose full API keys in stdout, chat, and key-bearing URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Return only redacted key status, avoid key query strings, and pass secrets through a protected secret store or stdin when needed.

remediation.issue: Local API keys are stored as plaintext without explicit file permission hardening.
remediation.suggestion: Write credentials with mode 0600, avoid broad-readable files, and prefer OS keychain or managed secret storage.

remediation.issue: The generic API request helper can send authenticated requests to broad ShareOne paths.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict allowed paths and methods to the documented workflows or require explicit user approval for administrative calls.

remediation.issue: The skill uploads local content to an external public sharing service.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the explicit publish confirmation step and clearly warn users before uploading confidential or regulated content.

semantic_findings.title: User-Controlled API Host Can Receive Credentials
semantic_findings.description: update_share_settings.js derives SHAREONE_BASE_URL from a full user-provided URL, then shareone_client.js attaches ShareOne credentials to requests built from that base URL. A malicious non-ShareOne origin could receive API keys or proxy-injected credentials during an update request.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly assigns the API base URL from the parsed input URL origin and later sends authenticated requests to getBaseUrl(). This is a concrete credential exfiltration path if the input origin is attacker controlled.

semantic_findings.title: API Keys Are Printed to Output and Chat Workflows
semantic_findings.description: check_api_key.js prints KEY_FOUND with the full API key, and create_guest_key.js prints generated keys. The workflow also instructs the agent to display generated keys and key-bearing account binding links to the user, which can expose credentials in transcripts and logs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited code and workflow explicitly output full API key values. This is not just secret access; it is intentional disclosure through process output and chat instructions.

semantic_findings.title: Local API Key Stored Without Permission Hardening
semantic_findings.description: shareone_client.js writes the ShareOne API key as plaintext JSON in the user home directory without setting restrictive file permissions. Other local users or backup tools could read the credential depending on the environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The credential path and write call are explicit, and there is no chmod or atomic permission handling nearby. The impact depends on host file permissions, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Publish files and links with ShareOne
content.value_statement: Sharing generated files often requires manual upload steps and link management. This skill publishes files to ShareOne and helps manage links, passwords, watermarks, downloads, and comments.
actual_capabilities: Publishes HTML, Markdown, and text pages to ShareOne and returns share links.
Uploads PDF, PowerPoint, Word, image, zip, and other binary files.
Applies optional passwords, watermarks, custom slugs, and comment settings.
Downloads allowed ShareOne files when the link and credentials permit access.
Reads, summarizes, processes, replies to, and resolves ShareOne comments.
Stores and uses ShareOne API keys from Sudowork secrets, environment variables, or local credentials.
limitations: Requires the ShareOne service and a valid API key or guest key for authenticated actions.
Uploads content to an external hosting service, so it is not private local storage.
Owner-only downloads and updates require the correct account credentials.
Public downloads depend on link permissions and may require a password.

use_cases.title: Publish a generated page
use_cases.description: Turn a local HTML, Markdown, or text file into a ShareOne link for review.

use_cases.title: Share a protected document
use_cases.description: Upload a PDF, presentation, or Word file with optional password or watermark settings.

use_cases.title: Close review comments
use_cases.description: Fetch ShareOne comments, update the source page, reply, and mark comments resolved.

prompt_templates.title: Publish a page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner upload for a local page file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish ./index.html to ShareOne and return the share link after I confirm the publish safety prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Share a document
prompt_templates.scenario: Add simple protection to a file share.
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload ./proposal.pdf to ShareOne with password 2468 and watermark Internal Review.

prompt_templates.title: Update link settings
prompt_templates.scenario: Change metadata on an existing ShareOne link.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this ShareOne link to enable comments and set the custom slug product-demo: https://shareone.app/s/example.

prompt_templates.title: Process review comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch unresolved comments from this ShareOne link, apply the requested page changes, republish, reply to each comment, and resolve completed items.

output_examples.input: Publish the latest dashboard HTML file and add a watermark.
output_examples.output: The skill confirms publishing is allowed, uploads the page, then returns the ShareOne link, backup link when available, and watermark status.

output_examples.input: Download this ShareOne file and summarize it.
output_examples.output: The skill downloads the permitted file, saves it locally, identifies the content type, and provides a concise summary.

output_examples.input: Resolve comments on an existing shared page.
output_examples.output: The skill lists unresolved comments, marks selected items in progress, updates the page, replies with changes made, and closes resolved comments.

best_practices: Review content and get explicit user agreement before any public upload.
Use passwords and watermarks for sensitive or limited-audience shares.
Use only trusted ShareOne links and trusted API base URL settings.
anti_patterns: Do not publish confidential files without clear user consent.
Do not expose full API keys in transcripts, logs, URLs, or screenshots.
Do not send credentialed requests to non-ShareOne or untrusted origins.

faq.question: What file types can this skill publish?
faq.answer: It supports HTML, Markdown, text, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, images, zip files, and other binary files.

faq.question: Does it require a ShareOne API key?
faq.answer: Authenticated publishing, updating, owner downloads, and comment processing require an API key or guest key.

faq.question: Can it protect a shared link?
faq.answer: Yes. It can set passwords, watermarks, custom slugs, and comment options when the API permits them.

faq.question: Can it update an existing link?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update text pages and change metadata on existing page or file shares.

faq.question: Can it download any ShareOne link?
faq.answer: No. Public downloads depend on link permissions and passwords. Owner downloads require matching credentials.

faq.question: Is uploaded content private?
faq.answer: No. The skill uploads content to ShareOne hosting and returns a shareable public link.
